question: Explain the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 on the time and place of holding the annual general meeting of a company.
sources: Companies Act, 2013 - section 96 annual general meeting

points.label: Duty to hold AGM
points.description: Every company other than a One Person Company must hold an annual general meeting each year in addition to any other meetings, and the notice must call it the annual general meeting.

points.label: First AGM
points.description: The first AGM must be held within nine months from the close of the first financial year; no AGM is then needed in the year of incorporation.
points.basis: Companies Act, 2013, first proviso to section 96(1)

points.label: Later AGMs
points.description: Later AGMs must be held within six months from the close of the financial year, and the gap between two AGMs must not exceed fifteen months.

points.label: Extension
points.description: For special reasons the Registrar may extend the time for any AGM other than the first by up to three months.
points.basis: Companies Act, 2013, third proviso to section 96(1)

points.label: Time and place
points.description: It must be held during business hours (9 a.m. to 6 p.m.) on a day that is not a national holiday, at the registered office or elsewhere in the city, town or village where it is situated; an unlisted company may hold it anywhere in India if all members consent in advance.
points.basis: Companies Act, 2013, section 96(2) and its provisos
